name: Warrior
text: +60 Health. Weapons deal 10% more damage with +10 armor penetration; unarmed +10 damage.

name: Thief
text: Pickpocketing 50% easier, 40% harder to detect, +20% sneaking speed, sneak without the perk. 20% chance to avoid physical damage, 1% chance to take 50% more.

name: Mage
text: +150 Magicka. Spells 30% stronger and longer while above 25% Magicka.

name: Apprentice
text: +5 Magicka regeneration per second, spells 20% cheaper. 25% weakness to magic.

name: Atronach
text: +300 Magicka, 25% chance to absorb spells, no Magicka loss when hit. No natural Magicka regeneration.

name: Lady
text: +40 Health and Magicka, both regenerate 80% faster. Run and swim without exertion.

name: Lord
text: +150 armor, +15% magic resistance, restore 1.5 Health per second. 30% weakness to fire.

name: Lover
text: 25% chance to take half physical and magic damage. Prices 15% better, shouts 20% stronger.

name: Ritual
text: Soul gems restore 50% more, blessings 50% stronger, Ritual powers. Its "stones 200% stronger" line is untested with LoreRim's stones.

name: Serpent
text: +15 armor penetration. Poison does 50% less to you; most paralysis does not affect you. Serpent's Curse power.

name: Shadow
text: 50% harder to detect, sneak without the perk, 30% quieter. Moonshadow power.

name: Steed
text: +60 Stamina, +10% move and sprint speed, restore 1 Stamina per second. Most slows do not affect you.

name: Tower
text: +50 carry weight, +4 lockpicking expertise, reflect 15% physical damage, +10% block, more gold from kills.
